messages:
anya: Quick thread to lock the MVP cut before the freeze. Two last-minute asks: (1) customer wants tenant-aware routing in the demo; (2) infra found intermittent mem pressure from embeddings cache in long soaks. My proposed cut: MUST: core REST generation, single-tenant SSO, telemetry + rollout hooks; MAY: emb cache dark-launch only if infra validates 48h soak; CUT: tenant routing and admin roles to v1. Decision rule below.

rio: I support cutting tenant routing. We cannot expose an unstable infra dependency in MVP. If infra validates a safe 48h soak -> dark-launch emb cache at 1% traffic with kill-switch.

sam: UX note: cutting tenant routing breaks our ACME demo. I can ship a 2-screen demo shim (fake tenant selector + read-only view) in ~3d to keep sales demoable. Low lift.

maria: Data: without the cache we observe ~18% p95 increase on recommend paths and ~3% CTR drop. If deferred, baseline perf capture needed so we can measure lift later: I'll create perf tickets.

oliver: Infra: root cause looks like KV eviction tuning interacting with quantized layers. Hotfix ETA ~5 dev days + 2 validation days. I can attempt a 48h mitigation spike but not guaranteed. If product wants emb cache in MVP we need to slide internal readiness by ~8 business days.

anya: Decision rule: If infra posts a validated hotfix + 48h soak before EOD Wed -> path A: dark-launch emb cache (1% traffic) with strict SLA and rollback; Else -> path B: cut emb cache to v1 and ship sam's demo shim. Canary SLA: generation p95 < 300ms, error-rate delta < 0.5%, cost delta < 1.5x. Any violation -> immediate rollback.

rio: If path B, add emb cache to the v1 milestone and assign infra+product owners with a landing target. Also communicate to sales immediately.

sam: I'll start the demo-shim spike today and post an estimate by EOD.

maria: I'll queue baseline perf runs and create tickets: `perf/embcache/baseline` and `perf/embcache/post-enable`. Will also add feature flag metrics (`feature.embcache`, `exp.embcache.cohort`).

oliver: I'll post the mitigation spike result by tomorrow noon. If it succeeds we may do path A.

anya: Action items: (1) oliver confirm soak result, (2) sam spike demo-shim estimate, (3) maria perf tickets, (4) rio update roadmap milestones & comms. Reconvene tomorrow 10:00 for final call. deploy-bot: milestone:Q2-MVP freeze updated by anya status: "scopegate-pending-infra".
